_note: PROPOSED targets for the web service report line 'Month N of 12 in your lawn program' (GATE_REPORT_WEB_PROGRAM). No approved per-month target table existed in the repo (lawn-protocol-v13.json and lawn-expectations hold products and timing, not score targets), so these are conservative placeholders for the owner to approve or change. byMonth[0] is program month 1, counted from the first lawn assessment at this property (property-scoped history, reset by a move); byMonth[11] is month 12 and also the bar for every later year. A score is on track from the target up to the target plus the band, ahead from the target plus the band, behind below the target minus the band. band is 8 points, the same per-category band lawn-progress.js and lawn-since-last use. Scores are the 0-100 category scores the report already prints: coverage = turfDensity, color = colorHealth, weeds = weedSuppression.

sentences.month: Month {n} of 12 in your lawn program.
sentences.on_track: {label} {verb} on track at this point in the program.
sentences.ahead: {label} {verb} ahead of where the program aims to be at this point.
sentences.behind: {label} {verb} behind where the program aims to be at this point.
